//: Build config for the serverless API. Kept separate from the app's project because the API targets Node globals (Request/Response from @types/node) rather than the DOM. The `@/*` path mapping exists so that the shared modules under src/ typecheck when imported from here — every `@/` import they make is type-only, so nothing needs that alias to resolve at runtime, which matters because Vercel's Node runtime does not support tsconfig path mappings.
